issuer: the licensing authority of the holder's municipality in Mendoza
note: Read 2026-10-30 on argentina.gob.ar. The Traffic Law (Ley 24.449, updated text) sets the age for every jurisdiction: 17 for the classes other than C, D and E (Art. 11), a minor needing a legal representative's authority; and licences are given for up to five years (Art. 13); the National Road Safety Agency's table of classes gives class B.1 (cars) from 17 to 65 for 5 years. The licence is issued by the local authority, which sets its own fee with the national one; Mendoza's weren't read, so the fee is null. The beginner's six months and the national identity document (DNI) aren't held here.
